caption: Temple of Portunus, Rome
composition: Ionic Temple of Portunus on the Forum Boarium podium · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the Temple of Portunus standing on its tall podium, the Ionic columns of its portico rising center-frame with the fluted cella walls behind. To the left stands the brick church of Santa Maria in Cosmedin with its campanile and rose window, shaded by umbrella pines. The 12:03 midday sun is strong under a clear blue sky, and the cropped lawn and ancient stone glow in the light.
